subject: prd/feature-brainstorm
statement: When a branch cannot yet be phrased as a precise question, the skill shall park it as a named fog entry typed by what it blocks — **blocking** when it sits on the destination or on a decision-shaped input of the PRD template (problem, segments, jobs, goals direction, non-goals, appetite), **non-blocking** otherwise — and while blocking fog remains, the skill shall recommend the needs-investigation verdict rather than proceeding toward ready-for-prd.
rationale: honesty about ignorance is a contract property (template rule 10); a papered-over gap becomes a fabricated requirement; untyped fog made ready-for-prd ambiguous (gate review 2026-07-09)
fit_criterion: on under-specified fixtures, zero fabricated resolutions appear and every seeded gap is named as a typed fog entry (EVAL-4); the destination-level and missing-decision-input fixtures end needs-investigation
